visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-width image (Iceland map) with positioned hotspot circles that open Dynamic Media video or 3D viewer media in a modal
visualCharacteristics.layout: image fills the block width; circles are absolutely positioned by left/top percentage over the image; media opens in a centred modal dialog with a 16:9 iframe

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = background image (picture, image link or plain-text URL); each following row = [media link or list of links (video /play URL or viewer URL), left position % (e.g. 38.5%), top position % (e.g. 39%)]

usage: Interactive maps or product images where points of interest open video or 3D media (6 hotspots on the WKND Travel Iceland map).
reuseGuidance: Use for any image with clickable positioned points that open embeddable media. Rows with no link or with non-numeric positions are skipped.
